context: Naoko and Yumiko share a long sisterly afternoon.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 優子さん、家族、皆、近くで、嬉しい。
lines.en: Yumiko—it makes me so happy to have everyone, the whole family, right here close.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried opening. Genuine appreciation in the voice, not performing. Soft attack on the name. Breath of quiet joy threading through the phrase. Tender without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本当、田舎、来て、よかった。
lines.en: It really was the right decision to come out here to the country.
lines.style: Settled and reflective, almost philosophical. Warm undertone. Slow enough to let the words land—a genuine realization spoken aloud. Soft, genuine.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Spending time together like this—it's truly a treasure.
lines.style: Earnest, almost reverent. Slight pause after the dash to let the weight of the thought settle. Voice quiet and full at once. Deep affection, unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: I'm grateful for it every single day, truly.
lines.style: Simple, unhurried. Quiet conviction beneath the words. Not rushing. A gentle acknowledgment of something deeply felt. Voice steady and warm.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: You're such a precious sister to me, truly.
lines.style: Voice softens on 'precious.' Slow pace, allowing tenderness to sit in the air. Unguarded affection. The words carry the weight of years. No performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Warm reciprocal tone. Echo of what was just said, but full in its own right. Gentle, matching. Not rushed. Voice steady with quiet assurance.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Slight catch in the voice, emotion held steady. Slow, deliberate. A quiet promise made across the words. Breath of sincerity. Closing warmth that lands softly.
